chapter_title_en: The Gate to the Primordial Celestial Realm
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 499: The Primordial Celestial Gate Opens
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen and the old farmer ascend a light path to a cosmic gate guarded by a universe. The Great Annihilation War Spear shatters the barrier, potentially opening the way to the Celestial Realm.
og_title: WoI Ch. 499: The Primordial Celestial Gate
og_description: A mysterious gate surrounded by a condensed universe appears on the path to the Celestial Realm. The old farmer wields the Great Annihilation War Spear to break through.
twitter_description: The Great Annihilation War Spear shatters the heavenly gate, opening a path to the Primordial Celestial Realm.
